jsb-if.name: uses a weight greater than the comparison omission equal to the threshold

jsb-else-if.name: misjudges 1 to 3 remaining digits as full quota

jsb-switch.name: Write the case of the cutting table in lowercase

jsb-for.name: starts counting from one but still limits count to less than width

jsb-while.name: The cycle continues on the day the target is reached

jsb-accumulator.name: Covering the total number in each round causes only the last row to be retained

jsb-function.name: Transfer the spare amount to the capacity of each cup

jsb-scope.name: directly overwrites the outer archive tag within the block
